long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: Unknown seeds that grow without permission keep bothering me, and I want to know more than I have been told.
I will draw the moon in the colour I am still unsure of, and keep the drawing where I can see it.
The telescope is mine, and a picture of it on record makes the claim stick.
Clay is good and I mean to keep something made from it, so I will take one more piece.
One piece of clay becomes a finished bowl at the workbench, and I keep what is mine.
Making things is tiring, and a patch of sun is the correct place to recover.
From a high place I can see everything that has not yet been claimed by me.

today.reason: The earlier plan is done, so I will read, draw and make one more bowl before a nap and a high watch, all on my own terms.
